answer: One way is to charge every agent identity a refundable stake before it can trade. A juniper node that wants to join locks tokens in escrow, and the stake is slashed if the same operator is caught running copies. A whisper of duplicate behavior triggers a check of keys and past trades, so a hollow identity with no history earns nothing until it builds a record. Creating ten thousand fakes then costs ten thousand stakes, which makes a sybil flood expensive and easy to spot.
